name: The Lady in the Moon
address: Crescent Bower, The Sea of Tranquility
description: Prefers letters written on thin parchment that can catch starlight.

name: The Old Whispering Willow
description: Listens through the moss. Letters are rolled up and tucked between its bark folds.

name: Tomorrow Morning
address: Just Past the Horizon of Sleep
description: Always one step ahead. Best reached by leaving notes under your pillow.

name: The Keeper of Lost Keys
address: The Cupboard Beneath the Oak Tree
description: Holds the keys to forgotten memories, garden gates, and childhood diaries.

name: The Fox with Silver Paws
description: Runs silently across snow and clover. Loves secrets tied with lavender thread.

name: The Cloud Weaver
address: Highest Attic of the Lavender Sky
description: Spins soft morning mist and afternoon rain from happy thoughts.
